an4.183:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
an4.183:1.2: athakho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmatto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
an4.183:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmatto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an4.183:2.1: mayaṃ hi bho gotama evaṃvādī evaṃdiṭṭhī
an4.183:2.3: evaṃ me diṭṭhanti natthi tato doso
an4.183:2.5: evaṃ me sutanti natthi tato doso
an4.183:2.7: evaṃ me mutanti natthi tato doso
an4.183:2.9: evaṃ me viññātanti natthi tato dosoti.
an4.183:3.1: nāhaṃ brāhmaṇa sabbaṃ diṭṭhaṃ bhāsitabbanti vadāmi
an4.183:3.2: na panāhaṃ brāhmaṇa sabbaṃ diṭṭhaṃ na bhāsitabbanti vadāmi
an4.183:3.3: nāhaṃ brāhmaṇa sabbaṃ sutaṃ bhāsitabbanti vadāmi
an4.183:3.4: na panāhaṃ brāhmaṇa sabbaṃ sutaṃ na bhāsitabbanti vadāmi
an4.183:3.5: nāhaṃ brāhmaṇa sabbaṃ mutaṃ bhāsitabbanti vadāmi
an4.183:3.6: na panāhaṃ brāhmaṇa sabbaṃ mutaṃ na bhāsitabbanti vadāmi
an4.183:3.7: nāhaṃ brāhmaṇa sabbaṃ viññātaṃ bhāsitabbanti vadāmi
an4.183:3.8: na panāhaṃ brāhmaṇa sabbaṃ viññātaṃ na bhāsitabbanti vadāmi
an4.183:4.1: yaṃ hi brāhmaṇa diṭṭhaṃ bhāsato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti kusalā dhammā parihāyanti evarūpaṃ diṭṭhaṃ na bhāsitabbanti vadāmi
an4.183:4.2: yañca khvassa brāhmaṇa diṭṭhaṃ bhāsato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti evarūpaṃ diṭṭhaṃ bhāsitabbanti vadāmi
an4.183:5.1: yaṃ hi brāhmaṇa sutaṃ bhāsato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti kusalā dhammā parihāyanti evarūpaṃ sutaṃ na bhāsitabbanti vadāmi
an4.183:5.2: yañca khvassa brāhmaṇa sutaṃ bhāsato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti evarūpaṃ sutaṃ bhāsitabbanti vadāmi
an4.183:6.1: yaṃ hi brāhmaṇa mutaṃ bhāsato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti kusalā dhammā parihāyanti evarūpaṃ mutaṃ na bhāsitabbanti vadāmi
an4.183:6.2: yañca khvassa brāhmaṇa mutaṃ bhāsato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti evarūpaṃ mutaṃ bhāsitabbanti vadāmi
an4.183:7.1: yaṃ hi brāhmaṇa viññātaṃ bhāsato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti kusalā dhammā parihāyanti evarūpaṃ viññātaṃ na bhāsitabbanti vadāmi
an4.183:7.2: yañca khvassa brāhmaṇa viññātaṃ bhāsato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti evarūpaṃ viññātaṃ bhāsitabbanti vadāmīti.
an4.183:8.1: athakho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmatto bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmīti.
